mission: Get people drawing together, finding friends, sharing artwork; kids-to-young-adults on tablets.

auto_apply: verifiable by screenshot or existing tests
gate_rules.escalation: Anything else goes to human_review with a note; rejected cards stay rejected unless NEW evidence appears.

backlog.title: Founding Artist empty-wall inversion
backlog.description: Make /wall's empty state an invitation: 'Be the Founding Artist' with a direct path to draw something destined for the wall. Includes redesign of the dead 2/3 whitespace S2 found.
backlog.gate: OVER EFFORT GATE (3 > 2); copy + layout redesign

backlog.title: Timelapse replay on wall
backlog.description: Replay how a wall piece was drawn, stroke by stroke, from the existing op-log series (src/utils/replay.js).
backlog.gate: OVER EFFORT GATE (4 > 2); playback UI + data plumbing

backlog.title: Twitch-pattern counted watchers + emotes
backlog.description: Show spectator counts and let watchers emote — the biggest 'attract watchers' lever (impact 9) but effort 5, new WS message types, and a moderation surface for a kids-to-young-adults audience.
backlog.gate: FAILS: effort 5 > 2; new realtime protocol + emoji-moderation surface on a minors-heavy app
backlog.review_note: Needs human call on moderation policy (emote set, rate limits) and protocol budget before any build.
backlog.owner_decision: 2026-09-16: moderation stance approved (animal aliases, no chat input, per-room watcher cap, host hide path intact)

backlog.title: Public spectate without admin key (/watch open to all)
backlog.description: Currently /watch is admin-key gated; zero public spectator surface (S2). Opening it is high impact for 'attract watchers' but changes who can see kids' live drawing sessions.
backlog.gate: FAILS: effort 5 > 2; safety/moderation surface (minors live on camera-equivalent), potential privacy policy implications
backlog.review_note: Owner must decide: opt-in per room? guardians? This is a product/safety decision, not an auto-apply patch.
backlog.owner_decision: 2026-09-16: moderation stance approved (animal aliases, no chat input, per-room watcher cap, host hide path intact)

done.title: Where the people are: busiest room first + honest empty state on /rooms
done.description: Re-scope of CARD-008 after its premise was falsified. Live counts were already wired; the real gap is that a flat grid of 20 identical 'Be the first!' cards never answers 'is anyone here?'. Busy rooms now sort first with a green highlight and a 'People are here now' badge; when nobody is anywhere the page says it once in a quiet line instead of 20 times.
acceptance: With a live peer: that room sorts first, carries 'People are here now', has the hot highlight (verified)
With nobody: featured order unchanged, no badge, single quiet line at 375px and 820px (verified)
No horizontal overflow at either viewport (scrollWidth == innerWidth) (verified)
done.verification_note: Verified by the orchestrator itself (sub-agents rate-limited on glm-5.3, HTTP 429). Same agent wrote and checked the code -> weaker than the S4/S5/S6 split; flag for a second pass when sub-agents recover.

selection.rationale: FINAL auto-cycle (3 of 3). CARD-002 (score 36, top of the ready queue) is the single strongest advance on 'two kids can find each other and draw together': with cycles 1-2 everyone lands in the shared MAIN room, but a kid still can't TELL a friend which room to join — codes are hidden behind clicks. Printing the code in big kid-readable type on every /rooms card enables mouth-share ('go to happypaint, type DINOS'). Lowest-risk pick: display-only in RoomFinderPage.jsx, fully gate-passing (reversible, no auth/payments/secrets/migrations/CI, screenshot-verifiable, effort 1). Cycle-3 capture (22 frames, 6 changed = home/join copy from CARD-013, no new majors) confirms board evidence unchanged; no new cards added. This closes the auto-patch budget for the day (3 of 5 used, 3 of 3 cycles). FOR HUMAN REVIEW NEXT: (1) CARD-011 watchers/emotes and CARD-012 public /watch remain blocked on safety/moderation policy decisions; (2) effort-3 backlog cards CARD-008 (live occupancy counts — strongest follow-on, pairs with CARD-002), CARD-009 (Founding Artist empty-wall), CARD-010 (timelapse replay); (3) remaining ready cards CARD-003 (onboarding step 4), CARD-004 (wall↔rooms stubs), CARD-005 (T-2h Pin-to-Wall nudge), CARD-006/007 (dead-cue + signup hatch fixes) are all gate-passing and can be queued for the next auto-patch day; (4) verify CARD-001..013 behave together end-to-end on the patched bundle at :8943 before merging loop/social-growth.
selection.budget_note: 5 auto-patches/day; 3 used after this selection (CARD-001, CARD-013, CARD-002). Cycle 3 of 3 — FINAL auto-cycle; loop pauses here for human review of the safety-gated cards (CARD-011, CARD-012), the effort-3 backlog, and an end-to-end regression pass on cycles 1-3.
